title: Recalling the Past to Answer the Present: Context-Aware Multi-Evidence Reasoning for Streaming Video Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2611.34545v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding, yet existing video question answering (VQA) benchmarks mainly evaluate models in offline settings. Real-world streaming scenarios instead require models to answer context-dependent queries by retrieving and reasoning over evidence distributed across the video history. We introduce StreamRecall, a benchmark for context-aware Multi evidence reasoning in streaming video QA. StreamRecall requires models to retrieve, associate, and reason over temporally scattered evidence to answer queries at the appropriate moment. It contains 4,983 questions over 462 videos, with context-aligned query times and fine-grained temporal evidence annotations. We further propose the Evidence Utilization Cascade to diagnose model reasoning through evidence localization, grounding, chain completion, and answer derivation. translated_title: 回顾过去以回答现在：面向流式视频问答的上下文感知多证据推理
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型在视频理解方面已取得显著进展，但现有的视频问答基准主要在离线设置下评估模型。而真实的流式场景要求模型通过检索并推理分布在视频历史中的证据，来回答依赖上下文的查询。我们提出了StreamRecall，一个用于流式视频问答中上下文感知多证据推理的基准。StreamRecall要求模型对时间上分散的证据进行检索、关联和推理，并在恰当的时刻回答查询。该基准包含462个视频上的4,983个问题，配有与上下文对齐的查询时间以及细粒度的时间证据标注。我们进一步提出了证据利用级联，通过证据定位、证据对接、证据链补全和答案推导来诊断模型的推理能力。为实现高效的长期流式推理，我们……
tldr: 该论文提出了StreamRecall基准与证据利用级联诊断框架，用于评估和诊断流式视频问答中模型对时间分散的多条证据进行上下文感知检索、关联与推理的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces StreamRecall, a benchmark for context-aware multi-evidence reasoning in streaming video QA, along with an Evidence Utilization Cascade that diagnoses how models retrieve, associate, and reason over temporally scattered evidence.
